# Soil moisture sensor calibration — 2026-09-17

**Test data, read-only.** Do not edit — an error here gets a knowledge
note or a question that links back to this record.

ADC readings (0–4095), capacitive sensor v1.2:

- in air (dry): 3120
- in a glass of water: 1340
- the manufacturer's datasheet suggests a range of 4095 (dry) – 0 (wet),
  which doesn't match the direction of the scale actually measured

Open question about this discrepancy — [[20-questions/Q-001-moisture-threshold-for-watering]].
